1.w: Hallelujah! Give thanks to YHWH for [He is] good, for His loving devotion [is] forever!

2.w: Who can describe the mighty acts of YHWH? Who can sound all His praise?

3.w: Blessed [are] those guarding justice, doing righteousness at every time.

4.w: Remember me, O YHWH, in favor [to] Your people; attend to me with Your salvation,

5.w: to look on the prosperity of Your chosen ones, [and] to be glad in the gladness of Your nation, [and] to glory with Your inheritance.

6.w: We have sinned, with our fathers; we have been perverse; we have acted wickedly.

7.w: Our fathers in Egypt did not consider Your wonders; they did not remember the abundance of Your kindness; and they rebelled by the sea—at the Sea of Reeds.

8.w: And He saved them for the sake of His name, to make known His might.

9.w: And He rebuked the Sea of Reeds, and it dried up, and He made them walk through the depths as through a desert.

10.w: And He saved them from the hand of the one hating, and He redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

11.w: For the waters covered their enemies; not one of them remained.

12.w: And they had faith in His words; they sang His praise.

13.w: They were quick to forget His works; they have not wait for His counsel;

14.w: and they craved with desire in the wilderness, and they tested God in the desert.

15.w: And He gave to them their request, and He sent leanness upon their soul.

16.w: And they were jealous of Moses in the camp, of Aaron, the holy one of YHWH.

17.w: The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan, and it covered over the company of Abiram.

18.w: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame consumed the wicked.

19.w: They made a calf in Horeb, and they bowed down to a molten image.

20.w: And they exchanged their Glory for the image of an ox eating grass.

21.w: They forgot God their Savior, the One having done great [things] in Egypt,

22.w: wonders in the land of Ham, fearful [things] by the Sea of Reeds.

23.w: And he said he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen one stood in the breach before His face, to turn away His fury from destroying them.

24.w: Then they despised the land of the desire; they were not faithful to His word,

25.w: and they grumbled in their tents; they did not listen to the voice of YHWH.

26.w: And He lifted up His hand against them to make them fall in the desert,

27.w: and to make their seed fall among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.

28.w: They even joined themselves [to] Baal-Peor, and they ate sacrifices to the dead.

29.w: And they provoked [Him] to anger with their deeds, and a plague broke out among them.

30.w: And Phinehas stood up and intervened, and the plague was restrained.

31.w: And it was reckoned to him as righteousness, to generation and generation, even to forever.

32.w: And they caused wrath at the waters of Meribah, and it was evil to Moses on account of them.

33.w: For they rebelled against his spirit, and he spoke rashly with his lips.

34.w: They did not destroy the peoples whom YHWH had given to them the order.

35.w: And they mingled with the nations, and they learned their works.

36.w: And they served their idols, and they were to them as a snare.

37.w: And they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to the demons;

38.w: and they shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and the land was polluted with the blood.

39.w: And they were defiled by their deeds and prostituted themselves by their practices.

40.w: And the anger of YHWH was kindled against His people, and He came to abhor His inheritance.

41.w: And He gave them into the hand of the nations, and those hating them ruled over them.

42.w: And their enemies oppressed them, and they were humbled under their hand.

43.w: Many times He delivered them, and they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity.

44.w: And He looked on the distress to them in His hearing their cry.

45.w: And He remembered unto them His covenant, and He relented by the abundance of His loving devotion.

46.w: And He appointed them for mercies before the face of all their captors.

47.w: Save us, O YHWH our God, and gather us from the nations, to give thanks to the name of Your holiness, to glory in Your praise!

48.w: Blessed [be] YHWH the God of Israel from forever and even to forever. And let all the people say, “Amen!” Praise YAH!
